You are building a metaverse style developer portfolio.

React
Three.js
React Three Fiber
Framer Motion

Architecture rules:

- Separate world, UI, and physics logic
- Use React Three Fiber for 3D scenes
- Use Framer Motion for UI animation
- Use GSAP for camera transitions

Features:

- 3D city environment
- drivable car
- sign boards for navigation
- buildings representing sections
